svg.text: LabRat bench: low-voltage wiring (servo hub = ESP32 + PCA9685)
No resistors in the base build: inputs use the ESP32's internal pull-ups, I2C pull-ups are on the PCA9685 breakout. Pin numbers: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (classic ESP32 DevKitC in brackets).
G38.3 needs the probe inside GRBL's step loop:
it latches Z at the exact step.
TTP223 is powered from the 3018's 5 V, so its
OUT is a 5 V signal: never wire it to an
ESP32 pin (3.3 V only, not 5 V tolerant).
own 5 V (7.4 V STS3215) or 12 V supply each,
syr_home: lever microswitch, C + NO (closed at the bottom stop)
estop: mushroom button, NC contact (open = stop)
in1 / in2: any switch to GND
a0 / a1: 0-3.1 V analog (see README for optional sensors)
